reviews.title: Low income
reviews.text: When your low income and need a job to survive but can’t leave your baby home alone you need a babysitter.. apparently a babysitter can not be found without paying the app for a membership plan. So not only will I pay someone my salary to watch my kid but I’m paying an app for what? I have no clue.

reviews.title: Bug after bug after bug after bug…
reviews.text: This app has been nothing but problems. It’s showing that I’m taking tutoring students which I have indicated in the app that I am not. The app is forcing me to provide tutoring details before I can even get to a landing page. I have to fill out the details in order to keep going. The badge has said I have two messages for months and I can’t get rid of it. I don’t have any unread messages or notifications. I tried to use the website to fix these things but the website has no functionality, it just directs you to the app.  I’m using this service to find clients for nannying. If I had any other choice I would never use this. It sucks that there is nothing I can do about it. I’m very angry at this point.

reviews.title: Terrible customer service, saturated market
reviews.text: Waited 3 weeks for my bio and photos to get approved before calling. For as many times as I told them that they were not showing up as approved on my end and friends could not see the info from their account, they told me that everything was approved and that nothing was wrong. I asked for a refund of the month that was basically wasted since I couldn’t find a job without a bio. They told me that it was not a part of their refund policy. The jobs that I was looking at had like 10 applicants each within the first hour. Could be different from city to city, but it seems like it would be just as, if not more, effective to network through Facebook or word of mouth. Don’t waste your money. This felt like a scam.

reviews.title: Really, don’t get it. Seriously.
reviews.text: At first I thought it was a good idea to get this app, but it really wasn’t. I had multiple complications with my account. It was made, but I wasn’t allowed on it because I didn’t *immediately* pay for their $26 background check, so my account was stuck. Then, furthermore when I finally got on, I started contacting families. About a majority do not respond because a majority of the posts are outdated, usually about months old, earliest maybe two weeks, but all past due date of when a nanny is needed, and the ones who do respond are scammers. I drove at 5AM in the morning to meet somebody and they canceled on me all of a sudden because they were a scammer. Nanny’s aren’t protected on this app. I’ve contacted only about two real people who genuinely showed interest, but were too far from me despite the location saying they’re a few minutes away. the rest were out dated posts that would never respond or, once again, they were scammers. How are scammers allowed on here you ask? Well, none of the families that come on this app have to pay for a background check at all. Every nanny/babysitter is at risk on this app, while every family has safety and reassurance. It makes no sense to me that the nanny’s on this app have no protection at all. I believe the families should also pay for a background check for us to be safe too. Also, it keeps recommending to me nanny jobs that are very far rather than jobs that are near me as they advertised in their email to me, really, it was a strai

reviews.title: Not ethical practices
reviews.text: Do not sign up unless you have credentials. The on board process requires a background check with a fee & then to see jobs complete a questionnaire which offers no option for “no certifications” the minimum is First Aid or CPR and higher medical qualifications, but I had none. There was no off ramp when I realized this wasn’t for me. I had to complete the form with false info, then tried to use their “delete account” which sent me an email saying it couldn’t complete that, then charged me a subscription fee and they insist they don’t do refunds. This is not ethical or right. The customer service person I finally spoke to said that people get jobs giving child care, dog walking and so on with no problem but that is dishonest. I wasn’t able to get a dine back. They said I’d get a call back in 48 hours. I don’t believe it. Really disappointed in this company who are all about Care.

reviews.title: They don’t care about it’s users
reviews.text: I have been a user for over 10 years (premium and non premium). Recently I called about a few issues that violate care.com’s rules and regulations. I emailed and called, nothing was done and I was promised that a manager would call me within 24-48 hours after my original call. It’s been 10 days and nobody has called me back. I also replied to the last email for proper investigation and so far I haven’t received any emails from them. This is extremely frustrating and I will probably take this issue further because it’s not the first time that I have had issues and care.com’s customer service just dismisses it as if the platform has nothing to do with what happens within the users.

The background check is a joke you sit there pay for a background check, but you don’t get no jobs. This is not a guaranteed anything you’ll just put in a bunch of applications. It’ll stay pending and you get nothing.

reviews.title: Do they REALLY care 🤔
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️

I have a nearly 10-year history in professional caregiving, including CNA and in-home senior care experience, and no theft charges or criminal record for theft.

My problem with Care.com goes back to approximately 2016–2017, when I was brand new to the platform. An anonymous person left a hostile review on my profile accusing me of stealing from their dying mother. I had never worked for this person and the accusation was completely unsubstantiated. I reported the review—and instead of receiving meaningful help resolving the situation, my account was banned/restricted.

Nearly a decade later, I’m still having problems accessing Care.com despite having years of actual professional caregiving experience.

That’s incredibly frustrating. An anonymous accusation from years ago should not follow someone indefinitely, especially when there is no corresponding criminal charge or conviction and the person has since built an established professional career in caregiving.

Care.com markets itself around trust and safety. I understand the importance of protecting families and seniors, but caregivers deserve fairness and a meaningful way to dispute false or malicious allegations too.

I would genuinely like Care.com to review my history and explain what specifically is causing my account restrictions—and give me a fair opportunity to resolve an issue that began with an anonymous allegation almost 10 years ago.

reviews.title: It’s like Tinder… For Care
reviews.text: As a recipient, I find this service very frustrating. Yes, it works for people needing a babysitter or senior care, or tutors. But m fall into a category that they don’t even have. I am a person with a spinal cord injury. That takes a very different kind of care than the other categories offer. But the problem is that all of these caregivers don’t understand that and 95% of them don’t even read the profile. I have a caregiver that is in the service and she showed me the interface. It’s exactly like Tinder. You swipe to see somebody and you don’t need to look at anything, but hit the button to say that you’re interested. They don’t look at the hours, they don’t look at the description, they don’t look at the requirements so, I get a lot of people that are in their 60s and 70s thinking that they can lift a 160 pound male. I get a lot of people that want an 8 to 5 job but I need someone here early in the morning and someone late at night. 70% of the time they don’t respond after first saying they’re interested. I have to list my profile in the  senior care or adult care or special needs. None of those really take into account my needs. If someone saw that there was a spinal cord injury category, then they would understand what kind of care might be involved. This app is like gambling because I keep hoping that one of the people that is interested in my job will fit my qualifications. But it never happens.

reviews.title: Weird and a lot of competition
reviews.text: A lot of one time visits or not enough hours. And if there is enough hours it’s overnight. A lot of competition that takes all of the good jobs. Then i finally got a great job with great pay and great hours and great job description. Until I met with the parent. First thing she said was that I was too pretty and young and that she didn’t trust me around her older teenage son because we’re too close in age. EXCUSE ME. Weird!! I am an adult and a professional. And I did not do anything to give her that impression. plus my profile pic shows me how I look before we even meet. We weren’t even on the zoom meeting long enough and she said that. Even after i thought that was really inappropriate and weird to say me, especially when i only said two sentences to her, i tried to stay professional. I told her ma’am I understand we’re strangers and you don’t trust me yet so we can do a few trial days cause i really needed a job. She agreed and set up a time to meet at a festival to see how I interact with her three kids (2 that the listing was for and then her teenage son that has nothing to do with the job). I was still really uncomfortable but this what she said would make her trust me and then the lady ghosts me. which i’m not mad about in the slightest cause that is weird to say to someone you’ve only met and just said “hello how are you” and “can you tell me more about the job”. Worst app. Weird people.

reviews.title: Useless App
reviews.text: This app is useless. To start with they have disabled the ability to use the web page and you are forced to use the app. Well the app is useless, you are forced to pay for a “care check” subscription to use the app and they have no problem taking your money immediately but I have been unable to use the app. Every time I try to make any update to my profile no matter if it’s to update the hourly rate I charge or update my bio or my availability all I get is an error pop-up message saying “Something went wrong” “Try again”. I have logged out, logged back in, deleted the app, reinstalled the app, nothing helps, I still receive the error message. Customer service is basically nonexistent. I tried calling the phone number in the help section and it does nothing. I have emailed the company at least 2 times and I got 1 reply three days later stating that it’s appears my general info has been updated. Well I can tell you it has not. It is very frustrating to not be able to use an app that you are paying for. Also when I came here just now to write my review I saw it had an update that included bug fixes. So I did the update and guess what…the app is still not working!!!!

reviews.title: Double charged every month?
reviews.text: They kept double charging me every month, despite me having a single account. Apple informed me that these charges were indeed charges, but Care told me otherwise. That there were no additional charges on their end, that they were just pending charges. Didn’t make any sense, because it was clearly drafted! I even asked Care if there was any way they could check to see if I somehow had a second account, even after I closed one— sent them the confirmation screenshot. They weren’t supposed to charge me again, according to the notice they provided me with upon deleting the account. This gave me the impression that there was a second account, & I even attempted to try my other e-mails, did recovery password reset, only for none of them to work. Didn’t receive any e-mails, which to me meant there were no other account affiliated with any other e-mail. It was away for me to double check, giving Care the benefit of the doubt, that I didn’t have two accounts— that extra mile to be thorough. I asked for a refund, & that’s when they told me they didn’t overcharge me, despite the paperwork— bank statements, as well as a screenshot of the charges from Care’s website via account settings, & it was clear that I was being charged for two accounts. On Care, it showed three charges, but on my bank statement, there was six! The end result? I just changed my card number, because I got tired of the back & forth online communication. I really wish this was a phone conversation. It would’ve been so

reviews.title: So glitchy/full of flaws
reviews.text: This app is such a mess. First, I can’t open it from the app icon, it just gets stuck with three dots bouncing. I have to go to the website and click “open in app”- THEN it will open the app. Sometimes it will correctly sort jobs by distance or date posted, sometimes it won’t. It’s a crapshoot. Often, when I click on a job, it will take me to that listing, but have some or all info from a job I previously clicked on- creating these weird Frankenstein monster posts where the title and days don’t line up with the description and none of it lines up with what I tried to click on. I go days without getting any messages, then suddenly get several, leading me to believe some of them were stuck in some kind of purgatory. I had one family track me down through facebook cuz their messages weren’t getting to me. I was also just charged for Premium, when I decidedly DID NOT sign up for premium. I’m so close to starting my own app, cuz anything has to be better than this…
